boundaries.name: kernel
boundaries.title: Transaction Coordinator, Swap, Witness, Journal, Reinit, JIT
boundaries.summary: Two-phase prepare/validate/commit across participants, journaled code and field edits, Triton JIT rebuild, and per-participant witness proof.

boundaries.name: adapter
boundaries.title: Engine-Core / Worker Reach, Step-Gap Quiesce, Graph Recapture
boundaries.summary: Hooks the running engine's step boundary across TP/PP/EP or Ray actors, quiesces in-flight work, and recaptures invalidated CUDA graphs.

boundaries.name: services
boundaries.title: Launcher, Weight Lease / Holder, Standby Pool, Resharder
boundaries.summary: Resident GPU/pinned-host weight holders, warm standby engine pools, IPC socket framing, and process-group teardown.

boundaries.name: zygote
boundaries.title: Pre-Import Fork Server & Module Refresh
boundaries.summary: Preloads heavy Python packages once before CUDA context creation, then forks warm worker trees that re-import edited modules.

boundaries.name: forksafe
boundaries.title: Pre-Fork CUDA Driver/Runtime Guard, GC Freeze, NUMA Binding
boundaries.summary: Blocks cuInit and bad-fork poisoning during pre-import, routes device queries through NVML/sysfs, freezes GC, and binds NUMA affinity.

boundaries.name: livestream
boundaries.title: Telemetry Stream, Step-Record Cross-Checker, Route Tier Classifier
boundaries.summary: Cross-checks per-rank witness counts, route tier ordering, and linked txn/proof/undo records.

boundaries.name: reconfigure
boundaries.title: Live Scheduler / Arg Delta Classification & In-Process Reconfig
boundaries.summary: Classifies CLI or trainer config deltas by restart tier and applies safe scheduler/hyperparameter updates in place after preflight checks.

boundaries.name: snapshot_restore
boundaries.title: KV-Cache Replay, RNG / Optimizer / Quantized Weight State Reset
boundaries.summary: Restores deterministic RNG, KV/Radix/Mamba caches, DataBuffer epochs, and byte-exact FP8/MXFP8 or coupled trainer-rollout weights.

topology.subtitle: V1 multi-process serving: HTTP frontend -> EngineCore scheduler -> TP/EP GPU workers
SPMD torchrun training: Gloo step-gap coordinator across TP/PP/CP/EP ranks
Sequence-parallel video generation: pinned weight holder + in-place stage rebuild
ZMQ Scheduler event loop per TP/PP/EP rank + RadixCache + CudaGraphRunner
Ray SingleController GRPO loop: TaskRunner -> WorkerDict + RewardLoop + Rollout
Disaggregated Ray RL: RolloutManager (sgl-router) <-> DataBuffer <-> Megatron/FSDP TrainGroup
